laura (release): Heads up — proposing we unpin runtime 2.14 for the quant rollout tomorrow 09:00 PT so we can exercise runtime 3.0's q4 optimizations. Any immediate blockers? @tariq

tariq (eng-runtime): Flag: we've seen a subtle tokenization/KV cache misalign on long contexts with quant-v4b on 3.0 in our internal perf tests. p99 spikes and occasional OOMs on longseq repro. I can paste a short repro log.

laura (release): paste the repro here if possible, thanks. We need to decide soft-unpin vs staged canary.

(tariq posts): ```
[2026-03-18T22:14:02Z] host-7 runtime3.0 warn: kv_cache_mismatch detected for session 0x7fae
[2026-03-18T22:14:03Z] host-7 runtime3.0 error: attempt to read kv at idx 4096 but size=4095 -> panic-free fallback triggered
[2026-03-18T22:14:03Z] host-7 runtime3.0 mem: resident rising from 4.2G -> 6.8G over 30s
```

sophia (ml): That's the pattern we saw in evals with sequences >16k tokens. Model doesn't error but runtime holds leaked buffers. Suggest a soft-pin strategy: canary 5% traffic, add a runtime shim to fallback to 2.14 on detects of kv mismatch, and immediate abort criteria.

jie (sdk): The SDK does have a small shim we can enable that rewrites the request header to legacy tokenization for affected models. It's a config flip: `sdk.feature.runtime_legacy_tokenizer=true`. We can ship that as a canary-side flag rather than a global change.

laura (release): Ok plan proposal: 1) start canary at 05:00 UTC (09:00 PT) with 5% traffic to runtime=3.0 on prod-us-east-1/canary pool 2) enable SDK shim only for canary 3) monitoring + abort rules: p99 latency > 2x baseline OR >2% error/kv_mismatch events across canary -> immediate abort and rollback to keep pin. Anyone object?

ops-oncall: I can watch dashboards. Also suggest we add OOM/mem growth alarm per-host: if resident increases >1.5x in 60s -> trigger abort. I'll add oncall runbook note and slack alert.

laura (release): Great. Deploybot — please start the canary at 2026-03-19T05:00Z with the sdk shim flag enabled for canary targets. Command: `/deploybot rollout start --target runtime=3.0 --pool=prod-us-east-1/canary --traffic=5% --flags sdk.feature.runtime_legacy_tokenizer=true`

deploybot: `INFO` starting canary rollout: runtime=3.0 -> pool=prod-us-east-1/canary, traffic=5%, flags=[sdk.feature.runtime_legacy_tokenizer=true]. Canaries will be monitored for p99 latency, error-rate, kv_mismatch events.

(30m after start) tariq (eng-runtime): Canary telemetry coming in — initial 5% looks okay on throughput, but host-3 shows memory growth similar to the repro. Attaching sample logs:```
[2026-03-19T05:24:01Z] host-3 runtime3.0 warn: kv_cache_mismatch session 0x9ab
[2026-03-19T05:24:02Z] host-3 runtime3.0 mem: RSS 4.8G -> 8.1G over 40s
[2026-03-19T05:24:05Z] host-3 runtime3.0 error: allocation failed: transient
```

ops-oncall: p99 for canary doubled and kv_mismatch rate on canary is 3.8% -> exceeding abort threshold. Aborting per runbook.

deploybot: `ACTION` aborting rollout: observed abort-trigger events (kv_mismatch rate=3.8%, p99 latency=2.2x baseline). Rolling affected canary targets back to runtime=2.14.

laura (release): Confirmed rollback completed. We'll keep the runtime pinned. Thanks @tariq @sophia @jie @ops-oncall. Follow-ups: tariq to triage memory growth root cause, sophia to re-run evals with additional mem checks, jie to prepare a safer opt-in path for SDK shim if we want to trial again.

tariq (eng-runtime): I'll open an RFC and include heap traces + a minimal repro container. Quick note: since we aborted, please do not unpin in tomorrow's change window until we have a mitigation.

laura (release): Copy. I'll update the release calendar and notify PMs. :white_check_mark:
